    scopes: text("scopes").default(sql`''`).notNull(),
    codeChallenge: text("code_challenge"),
    codeChallengeMethod: text("code_challenge_method"),
    expiresIn: integer("expires_in").notNull(),
    revokedAt: timestamp("revoked_at", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }),
    resourceOwnerId: bigint("resource_owner_id", { mode: "number" }).references((): AnyPgColumn => users.id, { onDelete: "no action" }).notNull(),
    applicationId: bigint("application_id", { mode: "number" }).references((): AnyPgColumn => oauthApplications.id, { onDelete: "no action" }).notNull(),
    redirectUri: text("redirect_uri").notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }).default(sql`now()`).notNull()
}, (table) => ([
    index("oauth_access_grants_resource_owner_id_ix_59a715b").on(table.resourceOwnerId.asc().nullsLast()),
    index("oauth_access_grants_application_id_ix_ae81e09").on(table.applicationId.asc().nullsLast()),
])).enableRLS();

export const users = pgTable("users", {
    id: bigserial("id", { mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    displayName: text("display_name").default(sql`''`).unique().notNull(),
    homeLocationName: text("home_location_name"),
    email: text("email").unique().notNull(),
    status: usersStatus("status").default(sql`'pending'`).notNull(),
    descriptionFormat: usersDescriptionFormat("description_format").default(sql`'markdown'`).notNull(),
    passCrypt: text("pass_crypt").notNull(),
    passSalt: text("pass_salt"),
    newEmail: text("new_email"),
    languages: text("languages"),
    authUid: text("auth_uid"),
    preferredEditor: text("preferred_editor"),
    authProvider: text("auth_provider"),
    creationAddress: text("creation_address"),
    company: text("company"),
    dataPublic: boolean("data_public").default(sql`FALSE`).notNull(),
    emailValid: boolean("email_valid").default(sql`FALSE`).notNull(),
    considerPd: boolean("consider_pd").default(sql`FALSE`).notNull(),
    termsSeen: boolean("terms_seen").default(sql`FALSE`).notNull(),
    publicHeatmap: boolean("public_heatmap").default(sql`TRUE`).notNull(),
    homeLat: doublePrecision("home_lat"),
    homeLon: doublePrecision("home_lon"),
    homeZoom: integer("home_zoom").default(sql`3`),
    changesetsCount: integer("changesets_count").default(sql`0`).notNull(),
    tracesCount: integer("traces_count").default(sql`0`).notNull(),
    diaryEntriesCount: integer("diary_entries_count").default(sql`0`).notNull(),
    homeTile: bigint("home_tile", { mode: "number" }),
    diaryCommentsCount: integer("diary_comments_count").default(sql`0`),
    noteCommentsCount: integer("note_comments_count").default(sql`0`),
    creationTime: timestamp("creation_time", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }).notNull(),
    termsAgreed: timestamp("terms_agreed", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }),
    touAgreed: timestamp("tou_agreed", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }),
    description: text("description").default(sql`''`).notNull(),
    imageUseGravatar: boolean("image_use_gravatar").default(sql`FALSE`).notNull()
}).enableRLS();

    }),

        fields: [noteComments.noteId],
        references: [notes.id],
        relationName: "note_comments_noteId"
    })
}));

export const notesRelations = drizzleRelations(notes, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "note_comments": many(noteComments, { relationName: "note_comments_noteId" }),
    "user": one(users, {
        fields: [notes.userId],
        references: [users.id],
        relationName: "notes_userId"
    })
}));

export const usersRelations = drizzleRelations(users, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "changeset_comments": many(changesetComments, { relationName: "changeset_comments_authorId" }),
    "changesets": many(changesets, { relationName: "changesets_userId" }),
    "diary_comments": many(diaryComments, { relationName: "diary_comments_userId" }),
    "diary_entries": many(diaryEntries, { relationName: "diary_entries_userId" }),
    "friends": many(friends, { relationName: "friends_friendUserId" }),
    "friends_by_user_id": many(friends, { relationName: "friends_userId" }),
    "gpx_files": many(gpxFiles, { relationName: "gpx_files_userId" }),
    "issue_comments": many(issueComments, { relationName: "issue_comments_userId" }),
    "issues": many(issues, { relationName: "issues_reportedUserId" }),
    "issues_by_resolved_by": many(issues, { relationName: "issues_resolvedBy" }),
    "issues_by_updated_by": many(issues, { relationName: "issues_updatedBy" }),
    "messages": many(messages, { relationName: "messages_fromUserId" }),
    "messages_by_to_user_id": many(messages, { relationName: "messages_toUserId" }),
    "note_comments": many(noteComments, { relationName: "note_comments_authorId" }),
    "notes": many(notes, { relationName: "notes_userId" }),
    "oauth_access_grants": many(oauthAccessGrants, { relationName: "oauth_access_grants_resourceOwnerId" }),
    "oauth_access_tokens": many(oauthAccessTokens, { relationName: "oauth_access_tokens_resourceOwnerId" }),
    "oauth_applications": many(oauthApplications, { relationName: "oauth_applications_ownerId" }),
    "redactions": many(redactions, { relationName: "redactions_userId" }),
    "reports": many(reports, { relationName: "reports_userId" }),
    "social_links": many(socialLinks, { relationName: "social_links_userId" }),
    "user_blocks": many(userBlocks, { relationName: "user_blocks_creatorId" }),
    "user_blocks_by_revoker_id": many(userBlocks, { relationName: "user_blocks_revokerId" }),
    "user_blocks_by_user_id": many(userBlocks, { relationName: "user_blocks_userId" }),
    "user_mutes": many(userMutes, { relationName: "user_mutes_ownerId" }),
    "user_mutes_by_subject_id": many(userMutes, { relationName: "user_mutes_subjectId" }),
    "user_preferences": many(userPreferences, { relationName: "user_preferences_userId" }),
    "user_roles": many(userRoles, { relationName: "user_roles_granterId" }),
    "user_roles_by_user_id": many(userRoles, { relationName: "user_roles_userId" }),
    "changesets_via_changesets_subscribers": many(changesetsSubscribers, { relationName: "changesets_via_changesets_subscribers" }),
    "diary_entries_via_diary_entry_subscriptions": many(diaryEntrySubscriptions, { relationName: "diary_entries_via_diary_entry_subscriptions" }),
    "notes_via_note_subscriptions": many(noteSubscriptions, { relationName: "notes_via_note_subscriptions" })
}));

export const diaryEntrySubscriptionsRelations = drizzleRelations(diaryEntrySubscriptions, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "user_id": one(users, {
        fields: [diaryEntrySubscriptions.user_id],
        references: [users.id],
        relationName: "diary_entries_via_diary_entry_subscriptions"
    }),
    "diary_entry_id": one(diaryEntries, {
        fields: [diaryEntrySubscriptions.diary_entry_id],
        references: [diaryEntries.id],
        relationName: "diary_entry_subscriptions_diary_entry_id"
    })
}));

export const noteSubscriptionsRelations = drizzleRelations(noteSubscriptions, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "user_id": one(users, {
        fields: [noteSubscriptions.user_id],
        references: [users.id],
        relationName: "notes_via_note_subscriptions"
    }),
    "note_id": one(notes, {
        fields: [noteSubscriptions.note_id],
        references: [notes.id],
        relationName: "note_subscriptions_note_id"
    })
}));
